surface.$description: Semantic surface colors — opaque chrome (cards, dialogs, page background, scrim, inverse panels). Replaces v1 `background.*`. The `inverse` rows are designed to be paired with `text.inverse.*` / `icon.inverse.*` for dark-on-light surfaces like the snackbar interior.

disabled.$description: Background for disabled inputs and controls.

inverse.$description: Dark surface — snackbar, tooltip, dark-mode tile splits.

inverse-strong.$description: Slightly darker inverse for layered dark surfaces.
